universities.name: University of Chester
universities.description: The University of Chester offers more than 200 courses across foundation, undergraduate, postgraduate taught and research study, with its main Chester sites supported by specialist locations in Warrington and Birkenhead.
universities.tagline: Career-focused study in the historic city of Chester
highlights: More than 200 courses advertised to international applicants
Foundation, undergraduate, postgraduate and research routes
Exton Park, Queen's Park and specialist teaching locations
Dedicated international admissions and student experience support
universities.internationalStudents: International applicants receive country-specific admissions guidance, visa and CAS support, arrival information and help from the Student Experience team. Course availability, academic entry requirements and English requirements must be checked for the chosen programme.
universities.tuition: Published 2026/27 international fees are £11,250 for the foundation year of a bachelor's degree, £14,950 per year for standard undergraduate study, £15,500 for standard postgraduate taught study, £15,700 for the MBA, £15,627 for classroom PhD study and £19,822 for laboratory PhD study. Medicine and some professional courses have different fees.
universities.deposit: The published international student checklist requires a minimum £8,000 enrolment-fee payment at least five working days before the course start date and before travel. Offer-specific and course-specific deadlines apply.
universities.applicationFee: Free direct application for foundation, undergraduate, postgraduate taught and MBA study; research applicants use the separate research application route.
universities.scholarships: Eligible undergraduate and 12-month postgraduate taught applicants are automatically considered for the University of Chester International Scholarship Award. The university does not publish one universal award value; the award shown in the offer letter controls.
universities.entryRequirements: Academic requirements are course and country specific. For Nigeria, the university publishes WAEC/SSCE routes for foundation study, recognised diploma or HND routes for undergraduate entry, and a recognised bachelor's degree normally at 2:2/50%/GPA 2.4 or above for postgraduate study.
universities.englishRequirements: Requirements vary by course. The general international table starts at IELTS Academic 6.0 with minimum component scores for many taught courses. The Nigeria page confirms WAEC or NECO English at C/C6 or above for undergraduate study and C6 or above for postgraduate study; course exceptions apply.
universities.accommodation: University and partnership accommodation is available in and around Chester. Published 2026 options include catered and self-catered rooms, with first-year firm-choice applicants prioritised subject to the application deadline and availability.

universities.name: Wrexham University
universities.description: Wrexham University is a career-focused university in north-east Wales offering foundation, undergraduate, postgraduate and research routes, with practical learning and a compact campus close to Wrexham city centre and railway station.
universities.tagline: Career-focused and supportive study in north-east Wales
highlights: Foundation, undergraduate, postgraduate and research study
On-campus en-suite accommodation close to the city centre
Published WAEC and NECO English alternatives
universities.internationalStudents: The international team provides admissions, visa, CAS and arrival guidance. Applicants should use the international course and intake finder because not every university course is necessarily available to international students in every intake.
universities.tuition: Published 2026/27 international fees are £11,750 per year for undergraduate study, £12,500 for MA/MSc courses, £13,000 for the MBA and £16,000 for PhD study. Intensive pathways and professional doctorates are not assigned a value where the official page says TBC.
universities.deposit: The CAS policy states that the minimum deposit required before CAS is the amount shown on the applicant's unconditional offer letter. No single university-wide amount is published on the current international fees page.
universities.applicationFee: Wrexham University states that neither it nor its agents charge an application fee for any programme.
universities.scholarships: International undergraduate and postgraduate scholarships are advertised, but the current public international fees page does not publish one universal award value. Accommodation offers for 2026/27 separately advertise a limited 5% international accommodation discount for eligible non-NHS students, subject to availability and conditions.
universities.entryRequirements: Academic entry requirements are country and programme specific and must be checked through the official country pages and course page. Some programmes require portfolios, interviews, professional evidence or subject prerequisites.
universities.englishRequirements: The general undergraduate and postgraduate taught requirement is IELTS Academic 6.0 with no skill below 5.5; postgraduate research is IELTS 6.5 with no skill below 6.0. Accepted alternatives include LanguageCert, PTE, TOEFL, Cambridge, Trinity and country qualifications. WAEC English is accepted at C6 for taught study and C5 for research; NECO English is accepted at C6, subject to the published validity and individual assessment rules.
universities.accommodation: Wrexham Student Village offers furnished en-suite rooms on campus with bills, Wi-Fi and 24/7 security included. Published 2026/27 prices start at £132.50 per week for a standard single en-suite; availability and contract terms apply.

universities.name: York St John University
universities.description: York St John University offers undergraduate, postgraduate and research study from its city-centre York campus, with additional provision in London, and emphasises practical learning, community and lifelong careers support.
universities.tagline: Supportive, career-connected study in the centre of York
highlights: Foundation, undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral routes
Placement and professional-experience options on selected courses
Careers support available to graduates for life
universities.internationalStudents: International applicants can apply directly or through UCAS and receive country guidance, visa and CAS support. Applicants must confirm the teaching campus because York and London provision, fees and course availability can differ.
universities.tuition: Fees are programme specific. Verified examples for 2026/27 include £12,100 per year for Computer Science BSc, £14,900 per year for Law LLB, £11,800 for the standard one-year International Business MSc, £15,400 for its professional-experience route and £14,900 per year for full-time PhD study.
universities.deposit: Student-visa applicants normally pay 50% of the first year's tuition fee after an unconditional offer. For a two-year MBA or MSc with professional experience, the required deposit is 50% of the total course fee. Exemptions apply to specified sponsored and loan-funded students.
universities.applicationFee: The official direct-application page does not publish a university application fee. UniDoxia therefore records the application fee as unconfirmed rather than asserting that it is waived.
universities.scholarships: A £1,000 scholarship is published for eligible international fee-paying undergraduates enrolling on any undergraduate course at the York campus. Separate funding and research opportunities have their own conditions.
universities.entryRequirements: Requirements are course and country specific. Standard undergraduate pages publish UCAS tariff and GCSE-equivalent requirements; many taught postgraduate programmes require a 2:2 honours degree or equivalent, sometimes with relevant experience. Research applicants must identify a suitable supervisor and meet project-specific requirements.
universities.englishRequirements: For many courses the September 2026 standard is IELTS Academic 6.0 with no component below 5.5, with accepted alternatives including Cambridge, Duolingo, PTE, LanguageCert, Trinity, TOEFL and Oxford Test of English. MRes, PhD and regulated courses publish higher or different scores. The reviewed official pages did not clearly confirm WAEC or NECO as an English waiver, so UniDoxia does not claim one.
universities.accommodation: First-year undergraduate applicants can access university-managed or partner accommodation subject to published deadlines. Main sites have 24-hour security support and rent includes bills, Wi-Fi and contents insurance; a £200 advance payment is applied to the first instalment.
